notes.title: New game announcement - Sock It
notes.notes:
Hey all,
Since MMII was streamed at AGDQ, I thought it would be a good idea to put some stuff for my upcoming game here.

Meegah Mem was always a meme game, so I didn't put that much effort into it. This project is a project I'm legitimately trying my hardest with though. 

This game is called Sock It. It's a spiritual successor to Punch Out, and I'm planning on putting 12 wacky characters in, along with cutscenes and jogging segments.

[previewyoutube=xQ6b-dg5itc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

The game is mechanically similar with a few tweaks. You still use high and low punches to attack the opponent, but in this game just weaving to the side won't be enough. Different attacks have different cues, and require different actions to avoid. Some actions you dodge, some you dodge a certain way, and some you have to block. You can even parry blockable attacks with good timing for a chance to really counterattack!


The enemies are a lot weirder this time. You fight a 500 year old man, an amalgamation of cats, and even a refridgerator!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35415578/70a18c1a102701a18242c7ad1209c513d017515b.png[/img]
The Glass Cannon is very basic, and teaches you to counter attacks correctly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35415578/47c9e5598fea583ca17494bd8a2ecf5f3f979d29.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35415578/f4258152c1ddd28ee12b5dab8df30367c445daa7.png[/img]
Cats is... well... a bunch of cats in humanoid form. Beware their claws!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35415578/35674eb2843cd1e711223307313563c01ad098db.png[/img]
Vince is a refrigerator that feels unwell. Give him a wide berth when he chucks food!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35415578/0db68a1a1eb78481c9d23a3482002c02e5a6f44b.gif[/img]
Also, I plan to use lots of psudo 3d effects, as demoed in the main menu.

It's also in the Godot engine, so the hurdles of the last engine I used that contributed to my game being very messily coded/completely broken are not a problem. So far, it's very stable!

A steam page should be coming up with the demo. I'm planning on releasing it on the Steam Fest after next; I missed registration.

Hope you check this game out at some point! I'll probably have more news and stuff on my Youtube Channel

Also, shoutouts to LVCreed for speedrunning Meegah Mem II at GDQ!

Run is at 2 : 25 : 00 https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1262057821

notes.title: For those with legal concerns
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
I've found that some people have some legal concerns about my product. I just thought that I'd state that, for the record, this game is a parody, and is a tranformative work. This is due to these reasons:

1. All graphics and scripts are made by me.

2. Music is also performed by me, but I don't have perfect pitch, and perform with a kazoo, so the tracks are, as a result, original

3. The level design in general, while resembling the level design of Mega Man 2, actually differs a bit since I cut parts out due to lack of knowledge of how to code some enemies and obstacles.

If anyone has anything to say about this, feel free to let me know in the comments of this announcement. Thanks!

-Crapcom
